description.zh: 庇佑一名最前排的友军，使其获得400%攻击力的护盾，持续6秒，并使该目标在接下来6秒内受到伤害降低20%，会优先选择拥有【金苹果】的友军释放
description.en: Protects the frontmost ally, granting a shield equal to 400% ATK for 6 seconds, and reduces damage taken by 20% for the next 6 seconds. Prioritizes allies with [Golden Apple].

level2.zh: 护盾和受到伤害降低持续时间提升至8秒
level2.en: Shield duration and damage reduction duration increased to 8 seconds.

level3.zh: 持续期间该目标受到伤害降低40%
level3.en: Damage reduction during the effect increased to 40%.

description.zh: 祝福最虚弱的1名友军，恢复250%攻击力+目标15%已损失生命的生命值，该效果对拥有【金苹果】的友军额外释放一次
description.en: Bless the most injured ally, restoring 250% ATK + 15% of the target's missing HP. This effect is cast one additional time on allies who have [Golden Apple].

level2.zh: 恢复生命值提升至270%攻击力

level3.zh: 恢复目标25%已损失生命值
level3.en: Restores 25% of the target's missing HP.

level4.zh: 恢复生命值提升至300%攻击力

description.zh: 被动的，伊登战斗中赋予距离自身最近的友方前排友军【金苹果】（金苹果：获得伊登10%的攻击力，生命值，护甲和魔抗）
description.en: Passive: In battle, Idunn grants [Golden Apple] to the nearest front-row ally. [Golden Apple]: Gains 10% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.

level2.zh: 金苹果目标获得伊登15%的攻击力，生命值，护甲和魔抗
level2.en: The target gains 15% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.

level3.zh: 【金苹果】目标存活时，伊登受到伤害降低50%
level3.en: While the [Golden Apple] target is alive, Idunn takes 50% less damage.

level4.zh: 金苹果目标获得伊登20%的攻击力，生命值，护甲和魔抗
level4.en: The target gains 20% of Idunn's ATK, HP, Armor, and M-RES.

description.zh: 被动的，伊登即将阵亡时，召唤金苹果罩住自身，获得75%最大生命值的护盾，持续5秒，持续期间，护盾以每秒20%最大生命值的效率转化为自身生命值，该效果一场战斗只能触发一次
description.en: Passive: When Idunn is about to die, she summons [Golden Apple] to shield herself, gaining a shield equal to 75% of max HP for 5 seconds. During the effect, the shield is converted into HP at a rate of 20% of max HP per second. This effect can only trigger once per battle.

level2.zh: 获得100%最大生命值的护盾
level2.en: Shield increased to 100% of max HP.

level3.zh: 护盾持续期间伊登受到伤害降低70%
level3.en: Damage taken while the shield lasts is reduced by 70%.

level4.zh: 获得125%最大生命值的护盾
level4.en: Shield increased to 125% of max HP.

description.en: If the Ultimate's target is an ally with [Golden Apple], they gain an additional 40% of Idunn's ATK for 10 seconds.
description.zh: 终结技的目标若是拥有【金苹果】的友军，10秒内额外获得伊登的40%攻击力

level2.zh: 终结技的目标若是拥有【金苹果】的友军，10秒内额外获得30%会心率
level2.en: The target also gains 30% CRIT Rate for 10 seconds.

level3.zh: 终结技的目标若是拥有【金苹果】的友军，使目标10秒内获得霸体
level3.en: The target gains Super Armor for 10 seconds.

level4.zh: 终结技的目标若是拥有【金苹果】的友军，10秒内额外获得30%会心伤害
level4.en: The target also gains 30% CRIT DMG for 10 seconds.
